html:
An English rock band from Liverpool, active from 1960 to 1970, who led the explosion of British pop music around the world. They are the best selling music act of all time.

The members were John Lennon, Paul McCartney, George Harrison and, from 1962, Ringo Starr. They learned their trade in long nights in the clubs of Hamburg and at the Cavern Club in Liverpool, playing the American rock and roll they loved. Their manager, Brian Epstein, and their producer, George Martin, helped make them stars.

From 1963 "Beatlemania" swept Britain, and in February 1964 their appearance on American television launched the "British Invasion" of the United States. Lennon and McCartney wrote most of the songs.

From 1966 they stopped touring and used the studio as an instrument, with albums such as Revolver and Sgt. Pepper's Lonely Hearts Club Band (1967), which drew on Indian music, orchestras and studio tricks. They became a symbol of the youth culture of the 1960s. Tensions grew, and they split in 1970, each going on to a solo career.
sum: An English rock band from Liverpool, active from 1960 to 1970, who led the explosion of British pop music around the world. They are the best selling music act of all time.
